points.title: 早年漂泊
points.description: 亚历山大·汉密尔顿1755年出生于加勒比海尼维斯岛，是私生子。他的父亲是苏格兰贵族，母亲是法国胡格诺派后裔。父亲在他出生前就离开了家庭，母亲在他13岁时因热病去世。汉密尔顿的童年充满艰辛，但他展现出非凡的才华和求知欲。在尼维斯岛，他通过自学掌握了英语、法语和拉丁语，并开始在当地商业机构工作，这段经历培养了他对商业和经济的早期理解。
points.descriptionEn: Alexander Hamilton was born in 1755 on the island of Nevis in the Caribbean, the illegitimate son of a Scottish nobleman and a French Huguenot woman. His father left before his birth, and his mother died when he was 13. Hamilton's childhood was marked by hardship, but he displayed exceptional talent and thirst for knowledge. In Nevis, he taught himself English, French, and Latin, and began working in local commercial firms, which fostered his early understanding of business and economics.

points.title: 求学启蒙
points.description: 1772年，汉密尔经由当地长老们的资助前往北美大陆，在纽约的埃尔巴塔学院（现哥伦比亚大学前身）接受教育。在这里，他迅速展现出非凡的才华，完成了四年的学业仅需两年。汉密尔顿深受启蒙思想影响，特别是洛克和孟德斯鸠的政治哲学。他积极参与政治辩论，撰写支持爱国事业的论文，并开始关注美国独立运动。这段教育经历为他后来的政治生涯奠定了坚实基础，也使他确立了强烈的中央集权和联邦制国家理念。
points.descriptionEn: In 1772, Hamilton traveled to mainland America with funding from local elders and attended Elizabethtown Academy (now Columbia University). There, he quickly demonstrated exceptional talent, completing a four-year program in just two years. Hamilton was deeply influenced by Enlightenment thought, particularly the political philosophy of Locke and Montesquieu. He actively participated in political debates, wrote essays supporting the patriotic cause, and began to follow the American independence movement. This educational experience laid a solid foundation for his later political career and established his strong belief in centralized government and federalism.

points.title: 军旅生涯
points.description: 美国独立战争爆发后，汉密尔顿加入了大陆军，凭借其军事才能迅速晋升。他成为华盛顿将军的副官和亲密助手，参与了多次关键战役，包括特伦顿战役、普林斯顿战役和约克镇战役。汉密尔顿展现了非凡的勇气和领导才能，特别是在约克镇战役中，他指挥了决定性的进攻。在军旅生涯中，他不仅积累了军事经验，还深入了解了国家治理的复杂性。这段经历使他认识到强有力的中央政府的必要性，为他后来推动联邦宪法和强大的中央政府理念埋下伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of the American Revolutionary War, Hamilton joined the Continental Army and quickly rose through the ranks due to his military talent. He became Washington's aide-de-camp and close assistant, participating in key battles including the battles of Trenton, Princeton, and Yorktown. Hamilton demonstrated extraordinary courage and leadership, particularly at Yorktown where he led the decisive assault. During his military career, he not only gained military experience but also gained deep insight into the complexities of governance. This experience led him to recognize the necessity of a strong central government, planting the seeds for his later advocacy for the Federal Constitution and a powerful central government.

points.title: 法律与政治
points.description: 战争结束后，汉密尔顿在纽约学习法律并成为执业律师。他积极参与政治活动，成为联邦党的重要领袖。1787年，作为纽约州代表参加制宪会议，汉密尔是宪法的坚定支持者，并在《联邦党人文集》中撰写了其中51篇论文，有力捍卫了新宪法。他主张建立一个强有力的中央政府，强调商业、工业和金融的发展。在纽约，他还建立了纽约银行，推动经济发展。这一时期，汉密尔的政治理念逐渐成形，他相信精英治理和强大的中央政府对于新美国的稳定和发展至关重要。
points.descriptionEn: After the war, Hamilton studied law in New York and became a practicing attorney. He actively engaged in politics, becoming a key leader of the Federalist Party. In 1787, as a New York delegate to the Constitutional Convention, Hamilton was a staunch supporter of the Constitution and wrote 51 of the Federalist Papers, powerfully defending the new constitution. He advocated for a strong central government and emphasized the development of commerce, industry, and finance. In New York, he also established the Bank of New York, promoting economic development. During this period, Hamilton's political philosophy took shape, as he came to believe that elite governance and a strong central government were crucial for the stability and development of the new United States.

points.title: 财政部长
points.description: 1789年华盛顿当选总统后，任命汉密尔为美国第一任财政部长。在任期间，汉密尔实施了一系列影响深远的财政政策，包括建立国家银行、偿还国债、保护关税制度等。他的《关于公共信用的报告》奠定了美国财政体系的基础，促进了国家信用和经济稳定。汉密尔还积极推动工业发展，主张政府应支持制造业和基础设施建设。作为联邦党的领袖，他与杰斐逊领导的民主共和党展开激烈政治斗争。1804年，在与政治对手阿伦·伯尔的决斗中，汉密尔不幸中弹身亡，年仅49岁，结束了短暂而辉煌的一生。
points.descriptionEn: After Washington was elected president in 1789, he appointed Hamilton as the first U.S. Secretary of the Treasury. During his tenure, Hamilton implemented a series of far-reaching fiscal policies, including establishing a national bank, paying off national debt, and protecting tariff systems. His 'Report on Public Credit' laid the foundation for the American financial system and promoted national credit and economic stability. Hamilton also actively promoted industrial development, advocating that the government should support manufacturing and infrastructure. As a leader of the Federalist Party, he engaged in fierce political battles with the Democratic-Republican Party led by Jefferson. In 1804, Hamilton was fatally wounded in a duel with political rival Aaron Burr, dying at the age of 49, ending his brief but brilliant life.

supporter.zh: 汉密尔是美国建国之父中最具远见卓识的政治家之一。他建立了美国现代财政体系，奠定了美国经济繁荣的基础。作为联邦党的领袖，他成功推动了强有力的中央政府，确保了新国家的统一与稳定。汉密尔的教育背景、军事功绩和政治才能使他成为美国历史上最具影响力的政治家之一。他的《联邦党人文集》至今仍是研究美国宪政的重要文献，对美国政治思想产生了深远影响。
supporter.en: Hamilton was one of the most visionary statesmen among America's Founding Fathers. He established America's modern financial system, laying the foundation for the nation's economic prosperity. As a leader of the Federalist Party, he successfully advocated for a strong central government, ensuring the unity and stability of the new nation. Hamilton's educational background, military achievements, and political talents made him one of the most influential figures in American history. His Federalist Papers remain essential reading for studying American constitutional government and have had a profound impact on American political thought.

critic.zh: 汉密尔的中央集权理念和对精英政治的推崇遭到民主共和党人的强烈反对。他的财政政策偏向商业和金融精英，忽视了农业利益，加剧了社会不平等。汉密尔出身卑微却迅速跻身精英阶层，这种转变使他被批评为机会主义者。他与杰斐逊的政治斗争反映了美国建国初期深刻的政治分歧。此外，他作为私生子的身份也使他成为政治对手攻击的靶子，反映了当时社会对出身和道德的严格要求。
critic.en: Hamilton's centralist philosophy and advocacy for elite governance faced strong opposition from Democratic-Republicans. His fiscal policies favored commercial and financial elites at the expense of agricultural interests, exacerbating social inequality. Hamilton's rapid rise from humble origins to elite status led critics to label him an opportunist. His political battles with Jefferson reflected deep ideological divisions in early America. Additionally, his illegitimate birth made him a target for political opponents, reflecting the era's strict social standards regarding origins and morality.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，汉密尔被视为美国建国时期最具争议也最具影响力的政治家之一。他的经济思想和政治理念塑造了早期美国的发展方向。近年来，通过音乐剧《汉密尔》的流行，汉密尔重新进入大众视野，成为美国文化的重要符号。历史学者普遍认为，汉密尔对美国宪政制度的贡献与麦迪逊和华盛顿不相上下，但他的政治理念也反映了建国时期美国社会的深刻矛盾。汉密尔的生平体现了美国梦的复杂性，既有个人奋斗的成功，也有政治斗争的残酷。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Hamilton is regarded as one of the most controversial yet influential figures of America's founding era. His economic ideas and political philosophy shaped the early development of the United States. In recent years, the popularity of the musical 'Hamilton' has brought him back into the public eye, making him an important cultural symbol. Historians generally agree that Hamilton's contributions to the American constitutional system are comparable to those of Madison and Washington, but his political philosophy also reflected deep contradictions in early American society. Hamilton's life embodies the complexity of the American Dream, featuring both personal success and the harsh realities of political struggle.

self.zh: 真正的自由存在于一个强大的政府之下，而不是一个软弱无力的政府中。
self.en: Real liberty is found in a government that is strong enough to protect the rights of its citizens, not in a government that is too weak to do so.

others.zh: 汉密尔是美国历史上最伟大的财政天才，他不仅建立了美国的财政体系，还塑造了美国的经济未来。
others.en: Hamilton was the greatest financial genius in American history; he not only established America's financial system but also shaped the nation's economic future.
